sentence_stem: Although the comic strip was very short,
correct_completion: it made me laugh out loud.
full_sentence: Although the comic strip was very short, it made me laugh out loud.

options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, but 'although' requires a contrast with the first part of the sentence.

options.text: it made me laugh out loud.
it was drawn in black and white.
options.why_wrong: This describes the comic strip but does not contrast with its short length.

options.text: the characters were drawn in pencil.
options.why_wrong: This adds a detail about the drawing but does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the first clause. Portuguese speakers may choose a connector that marks cause or result here, so it helps to check that the second clause goes against what the first clause suggests.
translation: Embora a tira de quadrinhos fosse muito curta, ela me fez rir alto.
